summary.zh: 跟上 pi 0.85.1。目录有 GPT-6 Astra，思考档和 Codex 速度能对上线上。WebSocket 走同一套代理，OAuth 用量会自己刷新。远程网页的排序和卡片也能用了。
summary.en: Moves onto pi 0.85.1. GPT-6 Astra is in the catalog, thinking levels and Codex speed match the wire, WebSocket uses the same proxy as fetch, OAuth usage refreshes on its own, and remote sort plus cards work.

summary.zh: 三件套和 typebox 对齐。凭证改走 ModelRuntime，流包装认新的 streamFunction。
summary.en: The pi trio and typebox are aligned. Credentials go through ModelRuntime, and stream wrappers use streamFunction.

details.zh: AuthStorage 深路径还在适配层里，下次再跟 pi 时只改这一处。
details.en: The AuthStorage deep import stays behind the adapter, so the next pi bump only changes that seam.

title.zh: Codex OAuth 加上 GPT-6 Astra

summary.zh: 本地目录写入 gpt-6-astra。窗口按 Codex 合同 872K，不是 API 的 1M。
summary.en: The local catalog adds gpt-6-astra. The window follows the Codex contract at 872K, not the API 1M figure.

title.en: Thinking levels actually reach the model

summary.zh: 补上 thinkingLevelMap。xhigh 和 Max 不再被 pi 钳成 high 或 low。
summary.en: thinkingLevelMap is filled in, so xhigh and Max are no longer clamped to high or low.

summary.zh: 全局 WebSocket 和 fetch 用同一套出站决定，避免直连超时后悄悄退成 SSE。
summary.en: The global WebSocket uses the same outbound decision as fetch, so a direct timeout no longer silently falls back to SSE.

summary.zh: 标准、快速、超快。快速在线上发 priority。设置和 update_settings 都能切。
summary.en: Standard, fast, and ultrafast. Fast is sent as priority. Settings and update_settings can switch it.

summary.zh: 后台轮询用量。暂态失败不再把上次剩余数字擦掉。
summary.en: Usage is polled in the background. A transient failure no longer wipes the last remaining count.

summary.zh: 打开下拉时不再把自动滚动当成点外面。
summary.en: Opening the menu no longer treats the autofocus scroll as an outside click.

summary.zh: 远程壳补上 context-menu 的定位，菜单不再画在视口外。
summary.en: The remote shell gets the context-menu positioning, so the menu is no longer painted off-screen.

summary.zh: 卡片接口改走 chat 权限，iframe 带一次性 ticket，不再靠店主钥。
summary.en: Card routes use chat scope, and the iframe carries a one-time ticket instead of an owner key.
